consistencyBasisQuote: Your largest single-day profit must be no more than 40% of your total profit during the payout cycle.
notes: BASE PRICES (2026-10-19 capture, https://www.lucidtrading.com/ product picker): $123 / $192 / $307 / $410 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K (productPrices 108/172/272/365 + addonFees 15/20/35/45; the page renders "ONE TIME FEE $123 $90.60 | $192 $140.40 | $307 $225.40 | $410 $300.50"). The lower figures are VAULT coupon prices and are not stored as durable prices. Supersedes the August $135 / $185 / $285 / $370 ladder.
TIER-SPECIFIC TARGETS: $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 equal 5% / 6% / 6% / 6%, so profitTargets stays null.
EOD TRAILING MLL: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500; the line locks at starting balance plus $100 after the trail threshold.
DLL: none on $25K; $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 on $50K / $100K / $150K. It is a soft session stop unless MLL is reached.
PAYOUT: 90% trader split, 40% payout-cycle consistency, $500 request minimum, tier profit goals of $250 / $500 / $750 / $1,000, buffer equal to initial MLL plus $100, and no fixed request window.
TRADING TIMES: positions auto-close by 4:45 PM ET Monday-Friday and reopen 6:00 PM ET Sunday-Thursday; overnight and weekend holding are therefore false.
GENERAL RULES: news and automated systems are allowed. Trade copiers are allowed, but coordinated strategies, third-party trading and pooled risk are prohibited, so copyTrading is restricted.
REFUNDS: after trading begins, Lucid says paid fees are not refundable; unused-account exceptions are discretionary rather than guaranteed.

consistencyRules.appliesTo: LucidFlex evaluation with the 50% consistency add-on

consistencyBasisNote: Lucid's LucidFlex help pages give the 40% (50% add-on) threshold and a ratio, but no sentence states what profit the percentage is measured against, so the basis is left unset.
notes: PRICES VERIFIED (2026-10-19 capture, https://www.lucidtrading.com/ product picker): $89 / $146 / $293 / $407 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K (productPrices 79/136/258/372 + addonFees 10/10/35/35). VAULT coupon prices are not stored.
ONE-TIME FEE AND $0 ACTIVATION: LucidFlex has no monthly rebilling and no funded upgrade activation fee.
TIER-SPECIFIC TARGETS: $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 equal 5% / 6% / 6% / 6%, so profitTargets stays null.

RISK: the Daily Loss Limit is OPTIONAL, chosen at checkout, and applies to both evaluation and funded when on. LucidFlex Customization (https://support.lucidtrading.com/en/articles/16226050-lucidflex-customization, read 2026-10-20): "Daily Loss Limit On: A Daily Loss Limit is enforced on both evaluation and funded accounts; Results in a lower evaluation purchase price" and "Daily Loss Limit Off: No Daily Loss Limit is applied during either the evaluation or funded phase; Results in a higher evaluation purchase price"; "The DLL is a soft breach, so if you hit it you will simply be locked out until the next trading session." The DLL amount is published only in the homepage product picker (LucidPricingConfig, LucidFlex "DLL" and funded "DLL (Below Initial Trail)"): $600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K; it is a dollar amount, so dailyLossPct stays null, and no dailyLossUsd is stored because the stored prices are the DLL Off configuration (next note). EOD trailing MLL of $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 locks at starting balance plus $100.

PRICE vs DLL SETUP (live https://www.lucidtrading.com/ product picker, 2026-10-20): the stored $89 / $146 / $293 / $407 are the struck one-time list prices, which are the Woo product price plus the "no-dll" add-on fee (79+10, 136+10, 258+35, 372+35), i.e. the DLL OFF configuration. The picker script charges that fee only when the DLL toggle is OFF and, with DLL ON, shows "Limited time — Savings total $15" on the $50K card (fee $10 + limited-time promo $5). DLL ON list (product) price: $79 / $136 / $258 / $372; the page only displays DLL-ON prices with the VAULT coupon ($50.30 / $90.20 / $170.60 / $250.40 vs DLL OFF $65.30 / $105.20 / $215.60 / $295.40), which are not stored. Log: content/data/challenges/_captures/lucid-flex-dll-2026-10-20.json

PAYOUT CADENCE DEPENDS ON DLL (16226050, 2026-10-20): "Keep the Daily Loss Limit On and your funded account can request payouts during the trading session"; "With the Daily Loss Limit Off, payouts follow the regular end-of-day schedule." payoutFrequency on-demand is unchanged here; intraday requests need DLL On.
PAYOUT: 5 separate profitable days at $100 / $150 / $200 / $250, 90% trader split, $500 minimum, 50% of profit capped at $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000, and no fixed window after eligibility.
TRADING TIMES AND GENERAL RULES: 4:45 PM ET auto-close, no weekend/overnight holds, news and automation allowed, copy trading restricted to compliant non-coordinated use.
